about: Oak Bay is a district municipality on the east shore of Greater Victoria, British Columbia, between Victoria and the Haro Strait islands. Leafy residential streets, waterfront parks, and a village commercial centre define an older capital-region municipality—not a downtown core city. About 18,000 people live in Oak Bay.
